prompt: Complete the Phase 6 core by adding checkpoint-aware cycle continuation. Create src/ade/checkpoint_runtime.py with a provider-agnostic run_checkpointed_cycle(provider, *, task, source_name, store, policy=None, existing_checkpoint=None, start_fn=start_cycle_session, monitor_fn=monitor_cycle_session) API. If there is no recoverable existing checkpoint, start a provider session, persist a RUNNING checkpoint immediately after obtaining the session id, then monitor it. If a valid RUNNING checkpoint for the same task contains a provider_session_id, resume monitoring that existing session without creating a new session. On completion persist COMPLETED. On monitor/start failure, use plan_repair and the checkpoint transition helpers to persist PAUSED_QUOTA/HUMAN_WAIT/REPLAN/FAILED; automatically perform only bounded RETRY dispositions, persisting counters between attempts. Never silently resume HUMAN_WAIT or terminal FAILED checkpoints. Keep secrets and tracebacks out of persisted checkpoints. Return a structured immutable execution result describing the final CycleResult or checkpoint. Export the public API from ade.__init__. Add focused standard-library unittest coverage proving crash-resume with a preseeded RUNNING checkpoint does not call create_session, a fresh run saves RUNNING before monitor, completion saves COMPLETED, quota pause persists, human wait persists, retry is bounded, and mismatched task checkpoints are rejected. Do not add dependencies. Do not modify GOAL.md, SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, pyproject.toml, .github/workflows, scripts, or any .autodev files. Run exactly PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v before finishing.
title: Add checkpoint-aware cycle continuation
